title: Oklahoma Sales Tax: Rates, Rules & Compliance Guide
summary: Complete guide to Oklahoma sales tax: 4.5% state rate, local add-ons up to 11.5%, SaaS exemption, nexus rules.
body_markdown:
**Oklahoma Sales Tax Quick Facts**


**Oklahoma sales tax rate:**


4.5%


**Max state sales tax rate:**


11.5%


**Economic nexus threshold:**


$100,000 in aggregate sales of tangible personal property in the preceding or current calendar year


**What sales count toward the threshold:**


Taxable sales, excluding marketplace sales if the marketplace collected the tax


**Tax authority:**


Oklahoma Tax Commission


**Tax portal:**


OkTAP


**SaaS taxable:**


No


**Administration difficulty:**


2/5
